name: OBS Jukebox
description: Play a different song on your OBS stream than in game, with the OBS Jukebox plugin.

issues.info: Report problems on GitHub. Include your Geode log and say whether GD Sounds shows up in OBS.

pitch-shift-replacement.name: Pitch shift a different OBS song
pitch-shift-replacement.description: When another mod pitch shifts the game's music, OBS shifts the song it plays instead too.

update-mode.name: Updates
update-mode.description: Checks GitHub for a new OBS Jukebox once per launch. Updates install when Geometry Dash and OBS are closed, and never close OBS.
one-of: Install after I close GD and OBS
